messages.en: I'm planning to take some food to the flood victims at the hall this evening. Want to come along?
Yeah, I've bought some bottled water for them too.
I'll just have an iced milk tea, less sweet, please.
Sure, I've already placed the order with the shop. I'll bring it over later.

senses.en_definition: A human being; a person capable of thought and reason.

messages.en: I sent my boss the wrong file earlier. So embarrassing—I even managed to mess up something that simple.
We're only human. We're bound to make mistakes. Send the right file first, then let your boss know.

senses.en_definition: Feeling angry, especially at being deceived, insulted, or mistreated.
The feeling of anger or rage.
To scold or speak angrily to someone.

messages.en: Where are you? I've been waiting outside this restaurant for twenty minutes.
Sorry, don't be mad. I'm almost there—I took a wrong turn earlier.
Okay, I'll head inside first. Just come and find me in there when you arrive.
